observations.body: The strong bear weakness toward shared hope. Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves. Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

payload.posture: Read Romans 15:1–13 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the strong bear weakness toward shared hope. Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves. Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
